faqs.q: How does Amazon KDP calculate paperback spine width?
faqs.a: Amazon KDP multiplies your exact interior PDF page count by the paper thickness factor: 0.0025 inches per page for Black & White Cream paper, 0.002252 inches for Black & White White paper or Standard Color, and 0.002347 inches for Premium Color.

faqs.q: Why did KDP Previewer reject my cover even though I used 6×9 trim size?
faqs.a: KDP requires a single wraparound PDF covering the 0.125" outer bleed, back cover, calculated spine width, front cover, and right 0.125" bleed. Even being off by 2 pages or forgetting the 0.25" total vertical bleed causes automatic rejection.

faqs.q: What is the minimum page count to put text on a KDP book spine?
faqs.a: Amazon KDP requires at least 79 pages before allowing spine text, and mandates at least 0.0625" (1.6 mm) of clear margin on both sides of the spine fold.

faqs.q: What size is the ISBN barcode box on a KDP back cover?
faqs.a: KDP places a 2.00" wide by 1.20" tall barcode on the lower-right of the back cover, inset at least 0.25" from the bottom trim edge and 0.25" from the spine crease. PublishGuard leaves this box pure white automatically.

faqs.q: Can I convert my Word or EPUB draft directly to these exact KDP dimensions?
faqs.a: Yes. Click Format & Export My Book ($19 Pass) above to upload your .docx, .epub, .md, or .txt manuscript. PublishGuard typesets both the interior PDF and full bleed wraparound cover automatically.

titleChecker.guide_title: Amazon KDP Title & Subtitle Rules That Trigger Rejections

rules.title: Strict 200-Character Combined Ceiling
rules.detail: KDP enforces a hard 200-character limit across Title + Subtitle combined. Excess punctuation, colons, or keyword lists past ~100 subtitle characters trigger metadata rejections.

rules.title: Zero Sales Claims, Rankings, or Promo Language
rules.detail: Words like "#1 Bestseller", "Free Gift", "Bonus PDF", "Guaranteed Cure", or discount tags inside your title or subtitle violate KDP Metadata Guidelines.

rules.title: Option 1 Impersonation & Bestseller Collisions
rules.detail: Matching the exact title of an established commercial book in the same niche invites Customer Confusion / Option 1 blocking notices unless clearly differentiated.

rules.title: Author Name Must Be Human / Pen Name Safe
rules.detail: Avoid stuffing keywords into the Author field or inventing fake major publishing city lines in metadata fields.

faqs.q: What is Amazon KDP's Title + Subtitle character limit?
faqs.a: Amazon KDP allows up to 200 characters combined for Title + Subtitle, though subtitles longer than 100–110 characters often trigger manual keyword-stuffing reviews.

faqs.q: What is an Option 1 title collision on KDP?
faqs.a: When a new upload shares an exact or near-identical title with an established bestselling book in the same topic, Amazon may block or terminate the title for misleading customer expectations.

faqs.q: Which catalogs does this live title checker query?
faqs.a: Each scan checks both the Apple Books catalog and OpenLibrary in real time, then scores the combined metadata against PublishGuard's KDP policy rules.

faqs.q: Why should subtitles avoid dashes filled with search keywords?
faqs.a: Separating 5+ search phrases with colons, pipes (|), or commas in a subtitle is one of the top reasons KDP sends "blocked due to misleading metadata" emails.

faqs.q: Can I format my full manuscript right after verifying my title?
faqs.a: Yes. Click Format My Manuscript With This Title ($19) and your verified title, subtitle, pen name, and category will pre-fill inside PublishGuard Studio.
